description: Modern minimalist bedroom: white walls, vertical wood-slat accent panel, upholstered gray bed, floating dark-wood nightstand, warm pendant light, bare oak floor, mirrored wardrobe. Adds bedroom room-type coverage (prior fixtures were both living_room) and a high_end budget mode, with a cooler neutral/gray palette against the existing warm-Scandinavian fixtures.

input.userContext: Love the minimalist, uncluttered feel here — keep it calm and modern. It just feels a little unfinished; the floor is completely bare.
